title: Rescue four orphaned CI-RED-021 handoffs from worktrees
intent: Commit four dev orders / handoffs never committed to any branch in any repository. Unlike the earlier rescue batch these were not in the stale checkout - they were untracked files inside two long-lived worktrees under C:	mp, one level further out of sight, and surfaced only during a worktree cleanup audit. Content is byte-identical; nothing is edited.
behavior_change: None. Documentation only. The CI-RED-021 enforcement thread itself remains open on unmerged branches.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds 4 previously-uncommitted document(s) at their native path(s), verbatim.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: These files existed nowhere in git. Verified with `git log --all --oneline -- <path>`, which returned nothing for every one. Without this commit each is one disk failure from being lost.

commands_run: git log --all --oneline -- <path> -> no output for every file in this patch, confirming it was committed nowhere.
Byte-identity confirmed with diff against the rescued source before committing.
